readings.Aries: The fastest route is rarely the one worth taking. Today, slow down enough to see the better path. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Taurus: There is a conversation you've been delaying. The longer it waits, the harder it becomes. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Gemini: The version of events in your head is more interesting than what actually happened. Check the facts. Sleep on it before committing.
readings.Cancer: There is something in your environment that needs physical attention — a space, an object, a body. Attend to it. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Leo: There's a narrative about yourself you've been carrying that flatters you in the wrong direction. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Virgo: The person who doesn't appreciate your efforts — their appreciation was never the point. Reconnect with the actual point. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Libra: The relationship is worth saving. Saving it requires saying the uncomfortable thing. Go back to the original intention — it's still the right one.
readings.Scorpio: You have been in the dark long enough to know it. The light is coming and you will be ready. Something is about to become obvious.
readings.Sagittarius: The distance you put between yourself and difficult feelings is getting to be quite a distance. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Capricorn: The mountain is real. The view at the top will be real. Don't forget to look at the path you've made. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Aquarius: You are loyal to your ideas in the way others are loyal to people. Someone needs you to be loyal to them instead. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.
readings.Pisces: The grief hasn't finished moving through you. Let it continue. One conversation today matters more than the rest combined.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
